description.value:
Your vitality runs deep, granting you several benefits. Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As an action, you can spend a Hit Die to remove the weakened condition from yourself.

Once per long rest, upon finishing a short rest, you can spend a Hit Die to remove one level of exhaustion.

You have advantage on saving throws against necrotic damage.
